## Complete Chinese Idiom Dictionary (7,200+ Structured Entries)

### 坚定不移 (jiān dìng bù yí)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/jian-ding-bu-yi
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#NM8mn
- **English Meaning**: To be firm and unwavering; to stand resolute without change.
- **Chinese Definition**: 移改变，变动。稳定坚强，毫不动摇。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 《资治通鉴·唐记·文宗开成五年》推心委任，坚定不移，则天下何忧不理哉！”
- **Example Sentence**: Despite many setbacks, she remained 坚定不移 in her pursuit of justice.

### 随时随地 (suí shí suí dì)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/sui-shi-sui-di
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#1nOAxp
- **English Meaning**: Anytime and anywhere; at all times and places.
- **Chinese Definition**: ①指依照当时当地情形；在不同的时间、地点。②任何时间、地点；时时处处。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 清·周中孚《郑堂札记》卷一游山诗有时地之异宜，随时随地，设色布景，否者皆陈言也。”
- **Example Sentence**: You can access the internet随时随地 with your smartphone.

### 全力以赴 (quán lì yǐ fù)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/quan-li-yi-fu
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#KlFjj
- **English Meaning**: To give it your all; put forth one's utmost effort.
- **Chinese Definition**: 赴前往。把全部力量都投入进去。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 清·越翼《廿二史札记·五·东汉尚名节》盖当时荐徵辟，必采名誉，故凡可以得名者，必全力赴之，好为苟难，遂成风俗。”
- **Example Sentence**: She studied day and night, giving her all to pass the exam.

### 丰富多彩 (fēng fù duō cǎi)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/feng-fu-duo-cai
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#IJMvH
- **English Meaning**: Rich and varied; abundant and colorful.
- **Chinese Definition**: 内容丰富，花色繁多。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 峻青《秋色赋》一个不久前才由机关、工厂的业余戏剧爱好者所组织进来的吕剧团，演出了丰富多彩的节目，非常令人兴奋。”
- **Example Sentence**: The festival offers a rich and varied program of activities.

### 余波未平 (yú bō wèi píng)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/yu-bo-wei-ping
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#JGLUA
- **English Meaning**: The aftermath or repercussions of an event are not yet settled or resolved.
- **Chinese Definition**: 指某一事件虽然结束了，可是留下的影响还在起作用。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 无
- **Example Sentence**: The scandal's ripples were still being felt; the aftermath was not yet over.

### 脱颖而出 (tuō yǐng ér chū)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/tuo-ying-er-chu
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#1cVJss
- **English Meaning**: To stand out from the rest; to show one's talent or ability prominently.
- **Chinese Definition**: 颖尖子。锥尖透过布囊显露出来。比喻本领全部显露出来。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 《史记·平原君虞卿列传》使遂早得处囊中，乃脱颖而出，非特其末见而已。”
- **Example Sentence**: After months of hard work, she finally distinguished herself in the competition.

### 实事求是 (shí shì qiú shì)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/shi-shi-qiu-shi
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#PUkMX
- **English Meaning**: Seek truth from facts; be practical and grounded in reality.
- **Chinese Definition**: 指从实际对象出发，探求事物的内部联系及其发展的规律性，认识事物的本质。通常指按照事物的实际情况办事。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 《汉书·河间献王刘德传》修学好古，实事求是。”
- **Example Sentence**: In scientific research, we must always practice seeking truth from facts.

### 一如既往 (yī rú jì wǎng)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/yi-ru-ji-wang
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#IBs8T
- **English Meaning**: Just as in the past; as always; unchanged.
- **Chinese Definition**: 一完全；既往从前，已往。指态度没有变化，完全象从前一样。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 无
- **Example Sentence**: Despite his success, he remained humble, treating everyone 一如既往.

### 众所周知 (zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/zhong-suo-zhou-zhi
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#JlXgt
- **English Meaning**: It is known to everyone; as everyone knows.
- **Chinese Definition**: 大家普遍知道的。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 《玉娇梨》第二十回城中宣杂难住，莫苦就在众所周知石村卜一居，与白公为邻。”
- **Example Sentence**: As is known to all, honesty is the best policy.

### 一年一度 (yī nián yī dù)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/yi-nian-yi-du
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#IFY6T
- **English Meaning**: Once a year; annual.
- **Chinese Definition**: 指每年一次。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 宋·王安石《送吴显道》诗之五惟有春风应最惜，一年一度一归来。”
- **Example Sentence**: We celebrate Christmas once a year.

### 因地制宜 (yīn dì zhì yí)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/yin-di-zhi-yi
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#Nrry1
- **English Meaning**: To adapt measures to local conditions; to tailor actions to the specific circumstances of a place.
- **Chinese Definition**: 因依据；制制定；宜适当的措施。根据各地的具体情况，制定适宜的办法。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 汉·赵晔《吴越春秋·阖闾内传》夫筑城郭，立仓库，因地制宜，岂有天气之数以威邻国者乎？”
- **Example Sentence**: When farming in mountainous areas, farmers must 因地制宜 to choose the right crops for the terrain.

### 千方百计 (qiān fāng bǎi jì)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/qian-fang-bai-ji
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#LJ7vT
- **English Meaning**: By every possible means; using all methods and tricks to achieve something.
- **Chinese Definition**: 想尽或用尽一切办法。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 《朱子语类·论语十七》譬如捉贼相似，须是着起气力精神，千方百计去赶他。”
- **Example Sentence**: She tried a thousand ways and a hundred tricks to get the job.

### 息息相关 (xī xī xiāng guān)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/xi-xi-xiang-guan
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#SSTG6
- **English Meaning**: Two things are closely related and mutually dependent.
- **Chinese Definition**: 息呼吸时进出的气◆吸也相互关联。形容彼此的关系非常密切。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 无
- **Example Sentence**: Their success is closely tied to the team's effort, like two things intertwined.

### 层出不穷 (céng chū bù qióng)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/ceng-chu-bu-qiong
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#QjxMS
- **English Meaning**: To emerge in an endless stream; to occur frequently without end.
- **Chinese Definition**: 层重复；穷尽。接连不断地出现，没有穷尽。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 唐·韩愈《贞曜先生墓志铭》神施鬼设，间见层出。”《唐书·艺文志》历代盛衰，文章与时高下；然其变能百出，不可穷极，何其兴衰。”
- **Example Sentence**: New variants of the virus are emerging one after another.

### 引人注目 (yǐn rén zhù mù)

- **English Meaning**: to attract attention; to be eye-catching

- **Derivation / Origin**: 毛泽东《湖南农民运动考察报告》也有敲打铜锣，高举旗帜，引人注目的。”
- **Example Sentence**: Her bright red dress really catches your eye.

- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#S1gtQ
- **English Meaning**: The most urgent matter at hand; a top priority that requires immediate attention.

- **Derivation / Origin**: 《孟子·尽心上》知者无不知也，当务之为急；仁者无不爱也，急亲贤之为务。”

### 敲诈勒索 (qiāo zhà lè suǒ)

- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#Wp4ty
- **English Meaning**: To extort or blackmail someone by threatening or using force.

- **Derivation / Origin**: 曲波《林海雪原》三三一名宋福，一名王大路，专门纠察库仑比的淘金工作和山林工人，为非作歹，敲诈勒索，无恶不作。”
- **Example Sentence**: The gangster was arrested for trying to extort money from the shop owner.

### 名不虚传 (míng bù xū chuán)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/ming-bu-xu-chuan
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#LKslA
- **English Meaning**: Reputation is not false; one lives up to one's name or fame.
- **Chinese Definition**: 虚假。传出的名声不是虚假的。指实在很好，不是空有虚名。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 《史记·游侠列传》然其私意廉洁退让，有足称者，名不虚言，士不虚附。”
- **Example Sentence**: After tasting the famous dish, I had to agree it was truly delicious—the reputation was not false.

- **Derivation / Origin**: 明·朱柏庐《治家格言》一粥一饭，当思来处不易；半丝半缕，恒念物力维艰。”

### 如火如荼 (rú huǒ rú tú)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/ru-huo-ru-tu
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#Ply9w
- **English Meaning**: Describes something that is growing vigorously and irresistibly, like a prairie fire.
- **Chinese Definition**: 荼茅草的白花。象火那样红，象荼那样白。原比喻军容之盛。现用来形容大规模的行动气势旺盛，气氛热烈。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 《国语·吴语》万人以为方阵，皆白裳，白旗，素甲，白羽之缯，望之如荼。……左军亦如之，皆赤裳，赤，丹甲，朱羽之缯，望之如火。”
- **Example Sentence**: The movement spread like wildfire, growing with ru huo ru tu momentum.

### 不折不扣 (bù zhé bù kòu)

- **English Meaning**: Meaning 100%, complete, or to the fullest extent; literally 'without discount or reduction'.
- **Chinese Definition**: 折、扣出售商品时，按定价减去的成数。没有折扣，表示完全、十足的意思。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 老舍《女店员》第二幕如今的妇女跟男人不折不扣一样尊贵！”
- **Example Sentence**: He is a 100% honest person, truly reliable.

### 后顾之忧 (hòu gù zhī yōu)

- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#N3kG6
- **English Meaning**: Worry about future troubles; a lingering concern about something that could cause problems later.
- **Chinese Definition**: 顾回头看。来自后方的忧患。指在前进过程中，担心后方发生问题。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 《魏书·李冲传》朕以仁明忠雅，委以台司之寄，使我出境无后顾之忧。”
- **Example Sentence**: Before leaving for vacation, she took care of all the bills so she wouldn't have any rear worries.

### 纸醉金迷 (zhǐ zuì jīn mí)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/zhi-zui-jin-mi
- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#1bsHxz
- **English Meaning**: Describes a life of extravagance, luxury, and self-indulgence, often with negative connotations.
- **Chinese Definition**: 原意是让闪光的金纸把人弄迷糊了。形容叫人沉迷的奢侈繁华环境。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 宋·陶穣《清异录·居室》（痈医孟斧）有一小室，窗牖焕明，器皆金饰，纸光莹白，金彩夺目，所亲见之，归语人曰‘此室暂憩，令人金迷纸醉。’”
- **Example Sentence**: He left his simple country life for the paper-drunken, gold-crazed city.

### 力所能及 (lì suǒ néng jí)
- **Canonical URL**: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/li-suo-neng-ji

- **Game Challenge**: https://easyidiom.com/#SCiMe
- **Chinese Definition**: 服信服。心里嘴上都信服。指真心信服。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 《庄子·寓言》利义陈乎前，而好恶是非直服人之口而已矣。使人乃以心服，而不敢蘤立，定天下之定。”
- **Example Sentence**: 如今请出一个管得着的人来管一管，嫂子就～，也知道规矩了。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五十九回

- **Chinese Definition**: 师军队；名名义，引伸为理由。出兵没有正当理由。也引申为做某事没有正当理由。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 《礼记·檀弓下》君王计敝邑之罪，又矜而赦之，师与有无名乎？”《汉书·高帝纪》兵出无名，事故不成。”

- **Chinese Definition**: 渔人比喻第三者。比喻双方争执不下，两败俱伤，让第三者占了便宜。
- **Derivation / Origin**: 《战国策·燕策二》记载蚌张开壳晒太阳，鹬去啄它，嘴被蚌壳夹住，两方面都不相让。渔翁来了，把两个都捉住了。
- **Example Sentence**: 无
